name: Adam Game
source:
You wake up in a room you don't recognise, and a man who claims to be your boyfriend promises to take care of you. As time goes on, you begin to realise that his attachment for you seems unsettling.

[From [url=https://jellokat.itch.io/adam-game]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你在一个你不认识的房间里醒来，一个自称是你男朋友的男人承诺照顾你。随着时间的推移，你开始意识到他对你的依恋似乎令人不安。

[来自[url=https://jellokat.itch.io/adam-game]Itch.io[/url]]
